<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

namespace StationX\Yugioh\Infrastructure\Http\FormActions;

use PDO;

/** Native save_match_schedule adapter. Keeps its transaction and audit boundaries while legacy services migrate. */
final class SaveMatchScheduleHandler extends NativeFormHandler
{
    protected function perform(PDO $pdo, string $action, array $post, array $files): ?string
    {
        $matchId = (int) ($post['schedule_match_id'] ?? 0);
        if ($matchId > 0) {
            $matchScheduleStmt = $pdo->prepare(
                'SELECT competition_id, phase, status, scheduled_on, starts_at, venue, judge, notes FROM sx_ygo_matches WHERE id = ? LIMIT 1',
            );
            $matchScheduleStmt->execute([$matchId]);
            $matchSchedule = $matchScheduleStmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) ?: [];
            if (!$matchSchedule) {
                return 'calendario_bloqueado_regla';
            }
            if (
                in_array(
                    strtoupper((string) ($matchSchedule['status'] ?? '')),
                    ['FINALIZADA', 'FINALIZADO', 'COMPLETED'],
                    true,
                )
            ) {
                return 'calendario_bloqueado_finalizado';
            }
            $scheduledOn = $post['scheduled_on'] ?? '' ?: null;
            $startsAt = $post['starts_at'] ?? '' ?: null;
            $venue = trim((string) ($post['venue'] ?? ''));
            $scheduleGuard = ygo_validate_match_schedule(
                $pdo,
                $matchId,
                $scheduledOn,
                $startsAt,
                $venue,
            );
            if (!$scheduleGuard['ok']) {
                $pdo->prepare(
                    'INSERT INTO sx_ygo_audit_log (entity_type, entity_id, action, payload) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)',
                )->execute([
                    'match',
                    $matchId,
                    'blocked_schedule_by_rules',
                    json_encode($scheduleGuard, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE),
                ]);
                return 'calendario_bloqueado_regla';
            }
            $pdo->prepare(
                'UPDATE sx_ygo_matches SET scheduled_on=?, starts_at=?, venue=?, judge=?, notes=? WHERE id=?',
            )->execute([
                $scheduledOn,
                $startsAt,
                $venue,
                trim((string) ($post['judge'] ?? '')),
                trim((string) ($post['match_notes'] ?? '')),
                $matchId,
            ]);
            $pdo->prepare(
                'INSERT INTO sx_ygo_audit_log (entity_type, entity_id, action, payload) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)',
            )->execute([
                'match',
                $matchId,
                'reschedule_match',
                json_encode(
                    [
                        'before' => [
                            'scheduled_on' => $matchSchedule['scheduled_on'] ?? null,
                            'starts_at' => $matchSchedule['starts_at'] ?? null,
                            'venue' => $matchSchedule['venue'] ?? '',
                            'judge' => $matchSchedule['judge'] ?? '',
                            'notes' => $matchSchedule['notes'] ?? '',
                        ],
                        'after' => [
                            'scheduled_on' => $scheduledOn,
                            'starts_at' => $startsAt,
                            'venue' => $venue,
                            'judge' => trim((string) ($post['judge'] ?? '')),
                            'notes' => trim((string) ($post['match_notes'] ?? '')),
                        ],
                    ],
                    JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE,
                ),
            ]);
            $matchCompetitionId = (int) ($matchSchedule['competition_id'] ?? 0);
            if ($matchCompetitionId > 0) {
                ygo_rebuild_competition_calendar_events_from_matches(
                    $pdo,
                    ygo_current_season_id($pdo),
                    $matchCompetitionId,
                    (string) ($matchSchedule['phase'] ?? 'match'),
                );
                $competitionTypeStmt = $pdo->prepare(
                    'SELECT type FROM sx_ygo_competitions WHERE id=? LIMIT 1',
                );
                $competitionTypeStmt->execute([$matchCompetitionId]);
                if ((string) $competitionTypeStmt->fetchColumn() !== 'qualifier') {
                    ygo_reflow_active_qualifiers($pdo);
                }
            }
        }
        return 'calendario_reprogramado';

        return null;
    }
}

save_team_deck_links.original_source:
<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

namespace StationX\Yugioh\Infrastructure\Http\FormActions;

use PDO;

/** Native save_team_deck_links adapter. Keeps its transaction and audit boundaries while legacy services migrate. */
final class SaveTeamDeckLinksHandler extends NativeFormHandler
{
    protected function perform(PDO $pdo, string $action, array $post, array $files): ?string
    {
        $teamId = (int) ($post['team_id'] ?? 0);
        if ($teamId > 0) {
            $teamExists = $pdo->prepare(
                'SELECT id FROM sx_ygo_teams WHERE id=? AND active=1 LIMIT 1',
            );
            $teamExists->execute([$teamId]);
            if ((int) ($teamExists->fetchColumn() ?: 0) > 0) {
                $addDeckIds = $post['team_add_deck_ids'] ?? [];
                $removeDeckIds = $post['team_remove_deck_ids'] ?? [];
                if (!is_array($addDeckIds)) {
                    $addDeckIds = [];
                }
                if (!is_array($removeDeckIds)) {
                    $removeDeckIds = [];
                }
                $addDeckIds = array_values(
                    array_unique(
                        array_filter(
                            array_map('intval', $addDeckIds),
                            static fn(int $id): bool => $id > 0,
                        ),
                    ),
                );
                $removeDeckIds = array_values(
                    array_unique(
                        array_filter(
                            array_map('intval', $removeDeckIds),
                            static fn(int $id): bool => $id > 0,
                        ),
                    ),
                );
                if ($addDeckIds) {
                    $placeholders = implode(',', array_fill(0, count($addDeckIds), '?'));
                    $pdo->prepare(
                        "UPDATE sx_ygo_decks SET team_id=? WHERE active=1 AND team_id IS NULL AND id IN ($placeholders)",
                    )->execute([$teamId, ...$addDeckIds]);
                }
                if ($removeDeckIds) {
                    $placeholders = implode(',', array_fill(0, count($removeDeckIds), '?'));
                    $pdo->prepare(
                        "UPDATE sx_ygo_decks SET team_id=NULL WHERE active=1 AND team_id=? AND id IN ($placeholders)",
                    )->execute([$teamId, ...$removeDeckIds]);
                }
                $pdo->prepare(
                    'INSERT INTO sx_ygo_audit_log (entity_type, entity_id, action, payload) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)',
                )->execute([
                    'team',
                    $teamId,
                    'save_team_deck_links',
                    json_encode(
                        ['add' => $addDeckIds, 'remove' => $removeDeckIds],
                        JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE,
                    ),
                ]);
            }
        }
        return 'equipo_ficha';

        return null;
    }
}

save_player.original_source:
<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

namespace StationX\Yugioh\Infrastructure\Http\FormActions;

use PDO;
use Throwable;
use RuntimeException;

/** Native save_player adapter. Keeps its transaction and audit boundaries while legacy services migrate. */
final class SavePlayerHandler extends NativeFormHandler
{
    protected function perform(PDO $pdo, string $action, array $post, array $files): ?string
    {
        $id = max(0, (int) ($post['player_id'] ?? 0));
        $name = trim((string) ($post['player_name'] ?? ''));
        $alias = trim((string) ($post['player_alias'] ?? ''));
        $teamId = max(0, (int) ($post['player_team_id'] ?? 0));
        $deckIds = array_values(
            array_unique(
                array_filter(
                    array_map('intval', (array) ($post['player_deck_ids'] ?? [])),
                    static fn($value) => $value > 0,
                ),
            ),
        );
        if ($name === '') {
            throw new RuntimeException('El nombre del jugador es obligatorio.');
        }
        $pdo->beginTransaction();
        try {
            if ($id > 0) {
                $pdo->prepare(
                    'UPDATE sx_ygo_players SET team_id=?, display_name=?, alias=?, active=1 WHERE id=?',
                )->execute([$teamId ?: null, $name, $alias, $id]);
            } else {
                $pdo->prepare(
                    'INSERT INTO sx_ygo_players (team_id, display_name, alias, active) VALUES (?, ?, ?, 1)',
                )->execute([$teamId ?: null, $name, $alias]);
                $id = (int) $pdo->lastInsertId();
            }
            $pdo->prepare('UPDATE sx_ygo_player_decks SET active=0 WHERE player_id=?')->execute([
                $id,
            ]);
            $link = $pdo->prepare(
                'INSERT INTO sx_ygo_player_decks (player_id, deck_id, active) VALUES (?, ?, 1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE active=1',
            );
            foreach ($deckIds as $deckId) {
                $link->execute([$id, $deckId]);
            }
            $pdo->prepare(
                'INSERT INTO sx_ygo_audit_log (entity_type, entity_id, action, payload) VALUES ("player", ?, "save_player", ?)',
            )->execute([
                $id,
                json_encode(['team_id' => $teamId, 'deck_ids' => $deckIds], JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE),
            ]);
            $pdo->commit();
        } catch (Throwable $error) {
            $pdo->rollBack();
            throw $error;
        }
        return 'jugador_' . $id;

        return null;
    }
}

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

namespace StationX\Yugioh\Infrastructure\Http\FormActions;

use PDO;
use RuntimeException;

/** Native save_team adapter. Keeps its transaction and audit boundaries while legacy services migrate. */
final class SaveTeamHandler extends NativeFormHandler
{
    protected function perform(PDO $pdo, string $action, array $post, array $files): ?string
    {
        $id = (int) ($post['team_id'] ?? 0);
        $existingLogo = '';
        if ($id > 0) {
            $logoStmt = $pdo->prepare('SELECT logo_url FROM sx_ygo_teams WHERE id = ? LIMIT 1');
            $logoStmt->execute([$id]);
            $existingLogo = (string) ($logoStmt->fetchColumn() ?: '');
        }
        $logoUrl = $existingLogo;
        $values = [
            trim((string) $post['team_name']),
            trim((string) $post['team_city']),
            $logoUrl,
            strtoupper(substr(trim((string) ($post['team_code'] ?? '')), 0, 12)),
            strtoupper(substr(trim((string) ($post['team_symbol'] ?? '')), 0, 24)),
        ];
        if ($values[0] !== '') {
            if ($id > 0) {
                $pdo->prepare(
                    'UPDATE sx_ygo_teams SET name=?, city=?, logo_url=?, short_code=?, symbol=? WHERE id=?',
                )->execute([...$values, $id]);
            } else {
                $pdo->prepare(
                    'INSERT INTO sx_ygo_teams (name, city, logo_url, short_code, symbol, active) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 1)',
                )->execute($values);
                $id = (int) $pdo->lastInsertId();
            }
            $uploadedLogo = ygo_store_team_logo_upload($id);
            if ($uploadedLogo !== '') {
                $pdo->prepare('UPDATE sx_ygo_teams SET logo_url=? WHERE id=?')->execute([
                    $uploadedLogo,
                    $id,
                ]);
                ygo_record_logo_history($pdo, 'team', $id, $uploadedLogo);
            }
        }
        if ($competitionType === 'qualifier' && strtolower($competitionRuleset) === 'goat') {
            throw new RuntimeException(
                'El formato GOAT se organiza por liga y divisiones; no admite clasificatorios.',
            );
        }
        return 'equipo_' . $id;

        return null;
    }
}
